<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Valentina · Mis 15 Años</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#071a3a;--blue:#0e2e60;--gold:#d8b56a;--gold2:#f0d79a;--cream:#f7f0df;--ink:#182338}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:#030c1d;color:white;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
.page{max-width:760px;margin:auto;overflow:hidden;background:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 0 70px #0009}
.eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:15px}
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:50px 22px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 22%,#2b507f,#0b234b 45%,#071a3a 80%)}
.script{font-family:'Brush Script MT','Segoe Script',cursive;color:var(--gold2);font-size:78px;line-height:1}
.hero h1{font-size:44px;letter-spacing:7px;margin:20px 0 10px}
.hero .date{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#f4ead4}
.scroll{margin-top:75px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:3px;font-size:12px;animation:float 2.4s infinite}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(7px);opacity:.55}}

.intro{padding:82px 25px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-align:center}
.intro h2{color:#17345f;font-size:34px;margin:0 0 20px}
.intro p{font-size:19px;line-height:1.8;max-width:620px;margin:auto}

.memory{min-height:100vh;padding:58px 18px 70px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:30px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#071a3a,#0d2d5d)}
.memory.alt{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d2d5d,#071a3a)}

/* Marco elegante y, sobre todo, SIN recortar la fotografía. */
.photo-frame{width:min(92vw,650px);padding:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0d79a,#a97c2b,#f6dfa2,#8b6422);box-shadow:0 24px 55px #0008;position:relative}
.photo-frame:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px;border:1px solid #fff8;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.photo-inner{background:#020914;padding:8px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;min-height:220px}
.photo-inner img{display:block;width:auto;height:auto;max-width:100%;max-height:64vh;object-fit:contain;object-position:center center}
.memory-copy{text-align:center;max-width:600px;padding:0 10px}
.memory-copy h2{color:var(--gold2);font-size:31px;margin:6px 0 12px}
.memory-copy p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:#f4ead4;margin:0}

.calendar{min-height:78vh;padding:72px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#294d82,#071a3a 74%)}
.calendar h2{font-size:32px;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:2px;margin:0 0 24px}
.calendar-card{max-width:610px;width:100%;padding:25px 16px 30px;border:1px solid #d8b56a99;background:#071a3add;box-shadow:0 20px 55px #0007}
.week,.days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:7px}
.week div{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#d6bf88;padding:6px 0}
.days div{min-height:45px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:50%;font-size:14px}
.days .special{width:46px;height:46px;margin:auto;border:2px solid var(--gold);background:radial-gradient(circle,#ecd28f,#b88b34 58%,#674716);color:#071a3a;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #d8b56a1c,0 0 30px #d8b56a88;animation:glow 2s infinite;position:relative}
.days .special small{position:absolute;top:53px;color:var(--gold);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}
@keyframes glow{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px #d8b56a20,0 0 40px #d8b56aaa}}
.date-caption{margin-top:36px;border-top:1px solid #d8b56a55;padding-top:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.date-caption strong{font-size:21px;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:2px}
.date-caption span{font-size:13px;color:#f3ead5;letter-spacing:1px}

.message{padding:92px 25px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-align:center}
.message h2{color:#17345f;font-size:34px}
.message p{font-size:19px;line-height:1.85;max-width:650px;margin:18px auto}
.quote{font-style:italic}

.details{padding:85px 20px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-align:center}
.details h2{color:#17345f;font-size:34px}
.box{max-width:600px;margin:12px auto;padding:25px;border:1px solid #d8b56a;background:#fffaf0;font-size:18px;line-height:1.6}
.box strong{display:block;color:#8a6422;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.no-blue{font-weight:bold;color:#071a3a}

.rsvp{padding:90px 20px;min-height:75vh;text-align:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 25%,#294d82,#071a3a 72%)}
.rsvp h2{color:var(--gold2);font-size:32px}
.wa{display:block;max-width:520px;margin:12px auto;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:30px;color:white;text-decoration:none}
.thanks{margin-top:55px;color:var(--gold2);font-size:20px}

.music{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:50;width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:#071a3aee;color:var(--gold2);font-size:20px;box-shadow:0 5px 25px #0008;cursor:pointer}
.music-note{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:74px;z-index:50;background:#071a3aee;border:1px solid #d8b56a77;color:#f4ead4;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;opacity:0;transition:.3s}
.music-note.show{opacity:1}

.map-button{display:block;max-width:280px;margin:17px auto 0;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid #b88b34;background:#17345f;color:#f7f0df;text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.3px;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #0002}.map-button:hover{background:#214a80}
@media(max-width:520px){
 .script{font-size:64px} .hero h1{font-size:35px}
 .memory{min-height:91vh;padding:45px 12px 60px}
 .photo-frame{width:94vw;padding:8px}
 .photo-inner{padding:6px;min-height:170px}
 .photo-inner img{max-height:57vh}
 .memory-copy h2{font-size:27px}
 .memory-copy p{font-size:17px}
 .days div{min-height:39px;font-size:12px}
 .days .special{width:40px;height:40px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">
<section class="hero">
  <div class="eyebrow">UNA HISTORIA QUE COMIENZA</div>
  <div class="script">Valentina</div>
  <h1>MIS 15 AÑOS</h1>
  <div class="date">21 · NOVIEMBRE · 2026</div>
  <div class="scroll">DESLIZA PARA DESCUBRIR ↓</div>
</section>

<section class="intro">
  <div class="eyebrow" style="color:#8a6422">RECUERDOS</div>
  <h2>Hace quince años comenzó un hermoso cuento</h2>
  <p>Una historia llena de amor, sueños, sonrisas y momentos inolvidables que han iluminado cada paso de mi camino...</p>
</section>


<section class="memory ">
  <div class="photo-frame">
    <div class="photo-inner"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Recuerdo de Valentina 1"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="memory-copy">
    <div class="eyebrow">RECUERDO 1</div>
    <h2>Un pequeño comienzo</h2>
    <p>Cada sonrisa guarda una historia.</p>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="memory alt">
  <div class="photo-frame">
    <div class="photo-inner"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Recuerdo de Valentina 2"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="memory-copy">
    <div class="eyebrow">RECUERDO 2</div>
    <h2>Momentos para siempre</h2>
    <p>Cada etapa fue construyendo la historia de Valentina.</p>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="calendar">
  <div class="eyebrow">GUARDA ESTA FECHA</div>
  <h2>NOVIEMBRE 2026</h2>
  <div class="calendar-card">
    <div class="week"><div>L</div><div>M</div><div>M</div><div>J</div><div>V</div><div>S</div><div>D</div></div>
    <div class="days">
      <div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div>1</div>
      <div>2</div><div>3</div><div>4</div><div>5</div><div>6</div><div>7</div><div>8</div>
      <div>9</div><div>10</div><div>11</div><div>12</div><div>13</div><div>14</div><div>15</div>
      <div>16</div><div>17</div><div>18</div><div>19</div><div>20</div>
      <div class="special"><b>21</b><small>SÁBADO</small></div><div>22</div>
      <div>23</div><div>24</div><div>25</div><div>26</div><div>27</div><div>28</div><div>29</div>
      <div>30</div>
    </div>
    <div class="date-caption">
      <strong>21 DE NOVIEMBRE</strong>
      <span>7:00 P. M. · PEREIRA</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="memory ">
  <div class="photo-frame">
    <div class="photo-inner"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Recuerdo de Valentina 3"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="memory-copy">
    <div class="eyebrow">RECUERDO 3</div>
    <h2>Una niña que soñaba</h2>
    <p>Y cada sueño la acercaba un poco más a este gran día.</p>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="memory alt">
  <div class="photo-frame">
    <div class="photo-inner"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
